packet_size_estimator: characters / 4; estimated tokens, not provider tokenizer tokens
cohort_note: Stratified toward large packets; not representative for estimating production context-fit percentages.

metrics.automated_start_crosswalk: One-to-one provider-start match within 60 seconds; invalid or failed packet responses count as zero against the fixed hidden target denominator.
metrics.manual_audit: Timing-blinded agenda-match review of one provider chapter per episode; 18 matched, 1 ambiguous, 4 unmatched. This checks the crosswalk and is not full manual locator gold.
metrics.historical_manual_slice: The separate 16-meeting adjudicated slice and earlier 115/116 Gemini result are not pooled with this holdout.

deepseek_v4_1_flash.interpretation: Live context lower bound >562750 estimate, exact limit unmeasured.

kimi_k3.interpretation: Scheduler cap is below the earlier synthetic live success; do not raise it without separate operational review.

capacity_and_route_gates.shared_nvidia_capacity: Provider concurrency 3 is shared with Nemotron Ultra chapter-agenda work and other lanes; exact residual daily capacity is unmeasured.

routing_assessment.status: evaluation only; no production route assignment changed
candidate_bands: DeepSeek V4 is a small-request capacity candidate through its observed ~106k Orca free-route success, but does not solve long-context overflow.

Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite can overlap small requests and may extend beyond its conservative 101.8k scheduler gate when actual provider tokenization and TPM permit; do not equate this with a guaranteed input limit.
DeepSeek V4.1 remains the stronger long-context quality candidate based on the paired eight-packet development comparison; the fresh one-target miss is inconclusive.
Kimi K3 may add a higher-context overflow band, subject to resolving the manual-audit discrepancy and its configured scheduler cap.

chunking_screen: See 2026-09-27-chunking-development.json. On two development packets, chronological windows avoided measured Google TPM rejection but earliest-start merge scored 1/2 and 0/2; one offline confidence merge reached 2/2 on one packet only. Not ready for production.
limitations: The holdout packet cohort is enriched for large contexts and cannot estimate fleet fit percentages.
Only one provider chapter per episode was manually reviewed; this does not replace full manual locator scoring.
The holdout agenda-generation source is Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, while earlier development used frozen Mistral Medium 2508 agendas.
Capacity figures combine published/configured quotas and short observed runs; sustained daily throughput and residual capacity after other lanes are not measured.
AA is a general model index, not locator accuracy.
